title: No-free residual six: lemma L1 for (2^4) and (2^4,1)
summary: Lemma L1 (no derivative at a coordinate lying in exactly one negative quintic, of magnitude 1 or 2, and in at most one residual departure, of cost 2), certified over a 2221-case cover (4442 obligations, 3662 LRAT certificates, read_all018 ALL_L1_CASES_VERIFIED after a Codex audit). Accepted in 1534: excludes the whole patterns (2^4) and (2^4,1); 27 of 73 open.
